subject: Post-call bake-off: CloudEdge competitive test plan & owners
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.example.com>
To: Aisha Khan <aisha@cloudedge.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.example.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.example.com>
Date: Fri, 22 May 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call bake-off: CloudEdge competitive test plan & owners

Hi Aisha — great conversation earlier today. Thanks for walking us through the CloudEdge workload and your evaluation priorities. Per request, attached is a draft bake-off plan that maps tests, owners, timelines, and success criteria. Highlights below so we keep momentum: 

- Goal: Validate inference economics (cost / 1M tokens), P95 latency under target load, and model parity/quality versus CloudEdge's hyperscaler tests.
- Initial test battery (short): P95 latency (1k qps burst test), cold-start latency, throughput at 99% accuracy retention on your eval set, and end-to-end token cost over a 24h synthetic workload.
- Success criteria (proposal): P95 latency <= 120ms for <512 toks, cost <= 60% of comparable hyperscaler quoting for same throughput, and BLEU/ROUGE parity within 3% on your labeled prompts.
- Timeline: Kickoff (remote) proposal 05/27, test window 05/28–06/02, results review 06/04.
- Owners: Redwood tech lead (Sean) will run the perf harness; Sales (me) will manage scheduling and contract questions; Marissa will coordinate dataset/infra and provide final cost analysis.

Next steps for you: confirm the eval set we'll use (subset or full), whether you need data residency (we can run in us-west or eu-west), and whether procurement should be looped for billing/PO cadence.

Attached: cloudedge-bakeoff-plan.xlsx (test matrix + scripts), plus a small perf harness to run on your side if desired.

Warmly,
Rishi Malhotra
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.example.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments: cloudedge-bakeoff-plan.xlsx (spreadsheet, 12kb)
From: Aisha Khan <aisha@cloudedge.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.example.com>
Cc: procurement@cloudedge.ai
Date: Fri, 22 May 2026 12:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call bake-off: CloudEdge competitive test plan & owners

Thanks Rishi — appreciate the thorough plan. A few quick clarifications from our side after debriefing with ML infra: 

- Region: we prefer us-west for latency parity with our prod traffic.
- Data handling: the eval set contains PII-lite customer transcripts; we need to confirm redaction/redline for any logs shared back. Can Redwood accept masked samples only?
- Tests to prioritize for the first run: P95 latency at 500 qps, cold-start under 300ms (warm sessions excluded), and cost-per-1M tokens to match similar model families (we brought in the hyperscaler quotes you saw).
- Can you include a short script or template for how you'll measure token accounting and cost math? That will help our procurement and infra teams compare apples-to-apples.

We can do a 60–90 minute kickoff on 05/27 (prefer morning PT). Procurement asked me to confirm estimated spend for the test window so they can authorize a PO for the dedicated capacity (if needed).

I can share the eval subset once we confirm the NDA/data handling — happy to loop legal if helpful.

—Aisha
Aisha Khan
Head of ML Platforms, CloudEdge Inc.
aisha@cloudedge.ai

Date: Sun, 24 May 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call bake-off: CloudEdge competitive test plan & owners (internal)

Internal notes and asks (copying salient bits of Aisha's reply):

> - Region: we prefer us-west for latency parity with our prod traffic.
> - Data handling: eval set contains PII-lite transcripts; they need masked samples only.
> - Tests to prioritize: P95 @ 500 qps, cold-start <300ms, cost-per-1M tokens.

Plan:

I'll prepare a minimal acceptance test first (P95 smoke run) so we don't run the full battery until masking & PO are signed.

-Sean

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.example.com>
To: Aisha Khan <aisha@cloudedge.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.example.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.example.com>
Date: Tue, 26 May 2026 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Finalized: CloudEdge bake-off plan, owners, and timeline (kickoff 05/27)

Team / Aisha — thanks for the quick turn. Summarizing final commitments so everyone is aligned before tomorrow's kickoff (I booked 05/27 10:00–11:15 PT):

1) Confirmed timeline
- Kickoff: 2026-05-27 10:00 PT (Google Meet link on the calendar invite).
- Test window: 2026-05-28 to 2026-06-02 (inclusive).
- Results review: 2026-06-04 09:00 PT.

2) Owners & responsibilities
- Sean Gallagher (redwood): run perf harness in us-west, provide raw logs and aggregated P95/P99 latency numbers, and token accounting script.
- Marissa Cole (redwood): curate the masked eval subset, validate masking approach with CloudEdge legal, and produce GPU-hours estimate + cost projection for the window.
- Rishi Malhotra (redwood): coordinate scheduling, serve as single point for procurement questions, and consolidate post-test competitive summary.
- Aisha Khan / CloudEdge: provide masked eval subset and confirm whether they want us to seed a small portion of production-like traffic. Procurement to confirm PO authorization by 05/27 EOD where possible.

3) Success criteria (finalized)
- Latency: P95 <= 120ms for <512 tokens (measured in us-west under 500 qps sustained bursts).
- Cold-start: median cold-start < 300ms (measured on first request after long idle).
- Cost: Redwood total token cost <= 60% of stated hyperscaler baseline across the same throughput profile.
- Quality: end-to-end accuracy parity within ±3% on their labeled eval subset (per their metric).

4) Data handling & compliance
- We will only accept masked samples for post-test logs. Sean will redact request-level PII from logs before sharing. Marissa to confirm masking checklist with CloudEdge legal at kickoff.

5) Deliverables & attachments
- Attached: cloudedge-bakeoff-plan.xlsx (finalized test matrix), redwood-perf-script.sh (measurement harness), sample-logs-format.txt (expected log schema).
- HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/8241 — I'll update milestones after kickoff.

Aisha — please confirm PO timing and whether I should loop your procurement contact into tomorrow's kickoff. If anything above looks off, flag it now and I'll update the plan. Otherwise see you tomorrow at 10:00 PT.

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.example.com
+1 (415) 555-0192
